description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Engineering Thermodynamics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: engineering-thermodynamics

facts.claim: Open systems exchange matter and energy; isolated systems exchange neither

source.quote: An isolated system does not exchange matter or energy with its surroundings

facts.claim: The system is separated from its surroundings by a boundary

source.quote: A wall is a boundary restricting the transfer of some or all forms of matter or energy

facts.claim: First law = conservation of energy

source.quote: The first law of thermodynamics is a formulation of the law of conservation of energy

facts.claim: Energy crosses as heat and work

source.quote: the law distinguishes two principal forms of energy transfer, heat and thermodynamic work

facts.claim: Entropy of an isolated system never decreases

source.quote: the entropy of isolated systems left to spontaneous evolution cannot decrease

facts.claim: Heat flows spontaneously from hot to cold

source.quote: heat always flows spontaneously from hotter to colder regions of matter

facts.claim: Combustion: exothermic reaction of a fuel with an oxidant (usually oxygen)

source.quote: Combustion, or burning, is a high-temperature exothermic redox chemical reaction between a fuel (the reductant) and an oxidant

facts.claim: Complete (stoichiometric) combustion leaves no fuel or oxidant

source.quote: Complete combustion is stoichiometric concerning the fuel, where there is no remaining fuel, and ideally, no residual oxidant

facts.claim: Adiabatic flame temperature is the upper limit for real flames

source.quote: It is an upper bound of the temperature that is reached in actual processes

facts.claim: Boiler, turbine, condenser and pump; water/steam working fluid

source.quote: Heat energy is supplied to the system via a boiler where the working fluid (typically water) is converted to a high-pressure gaseous state (steam) in order to turn a turbine

facts.claim: Model of steam power plants

source.quote: The Rankine cycle closely describes the process by which steam engines commonly found in thermal power generation plants

facts.claim: Otto cycle models spark-ignition engines

source.quote: describes the functioning of a typical spark ignition piston engine

facts.claim: Compression and expansion are isentropic

source.quote: The isentropic process of compression or expansion

facts.claim: Brayton (Joule) cycle for gas turbines and jet engines

source.quote: The most common current application is in airbreathing jet engines and gas turbine engines

facts.claim: Also called the Joule cycle

source.quote: also known as the Joule cycle

facts.claim: Hot gas-turbine exhaust drives a steam cycle

source.quote: after completing its cycle in the first (usually gas turbine) engine, the working fluid (the exhaust) is still hot enough that a second subsequent heat engine can extract ene

facts.claim: Compressor, condenser, expansion valve and evaporator

source.quote: All such systems have four components: a compressor, a condenser, a thermal expansion valve (also called a throttle valve), and an evaporator

facts.claim: A refrigerant absorbs heat and rejects it elsewhere

source.quote: uses a circulating fluid refrigerant as the medium which absorbs and removes heat from the space to be cooled

facts.claim: Dry-bulb, wet-bulb and dew-point temperatures

source.quote: The term dry-bulb is customarily added to temperature to distinguish it from wet-bulb and dew point temperature

facts.claim: Choking happens at sonic speed (Mach 1) at the throat

source.quote: the exit plane velocity is at sonic conditions; i.e., at a Mach number of 1

facts.claim: Mass flow cannot increase by lowering downstream pressure further

source.quote: the mass flow cannot increase with a further decrease in the downstream pressure environment

facts.claim: A positive-displacement compressor with crank-driven pistons

source.quote: is a positive-displacement compressor that uses pistons driven by a crankshaft to deliver gases at high pressure

facts.claim: Multistaging (with intercooling) reaches high pressures

source.quote: are commonly produced by multistage reciprocating compressors

facts.claim: A steam turbine turns steam's thermal energy into shaft work

source.quote: extracts thermal energy from pressurized steam and uses it to do mechanical work utilising a rotating output shaft
